types.name: Fenrir::Colour
types.doc: A colour as linear red, green, blue and alpha, each a float, usually in [0, 1] (ADR-0025). Debug draw, materials and lights take it, and the renderer packs it for vertices. Colours written as sRGB hex values, as colour pickers and art tools give them, are converted when made (FromSrgb). Default constructed, it is opaque white.

types.name: Fenrir::DepthMode
types.doc: Whether a shape is hidden behind what is in front of it.

values.name: Tested
values.doc: Tested against the scene's depth, so geometry in front hides it (the default).

types.name: Fenrir::EntityValue
types.doc: A C# Entity: an entity's 32-bit value alone. The wrapper a native takes or returns where C# passes an Entity, and the field a shared struct holds where C# holds one.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptOptions::ShapeOptions
types.doc: A ShapeOptions without its group, as a native takes it.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: How long the item is kept, as ShapeOptions.Duration.

fields.name: relativeTo
fields.doc: The entity the positions are relative to, or Entity.None (Entity::Null).

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: Whether the shape is depth tested or drawn on top.

fields.name: segments
fields.doc: How many straight segments make a full circle of a round shape.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptOptions::TextOptions
types.doc: A TextOptions without its group, as a native takes it.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: How long the item is kept, as TextOptions.Duration.

fields.name: relativeTo
fields.doc: The entity the item is relative to, or Entity.None (Entity::Null).

fields.name: size
fields.doc: The height of the text in pixels.
